guard: spawn acceptances expose the connector-selected readiness budget and a synchronous caller follows through it instead of timing out on a shorter generic wait
completionMarker: E. the accepted readiness budget, not a shorter generic caller wait, bounds the follow
why: Issue #979 was reproduced with a real broker, manager and child: the fixed 40s caller wait returned deadline-exceeded at 40385ms while the child joined healthy at 43807ms inside its connector-declared 50s readiness window.

The first mutation restores that ordering bug directly in the generic action follower. The second proves the manager acceptance carries the exact connector-selected budget that the follower consumes, rather than a re-spelled global constant.
Both suites import built workspace packages, so each mutation command rebuilds the affected package before running its named assertion.

mutations.name: the follower ignores the accepted readiness budget and uses only the shorter caller wait
mutations.expectRed: a terminal inside the accepted readiness budget outlives the shorter generic caller wait
mutations.cell: a terminal inside the accepted readiness budget outlives the shorter generic caller wait

mutations.name: the manager acceptance reports its generic default instead of the connector-selected readiness budget
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && pnpm smoke:manager-service-invoke
mutations.completionMarker: 3. invoke spawn (the recompiled input contract gates args)
mutations.expectRed: invoke spawn accepts the goal with the exact connector readiness budget a follower must outlive
mutations.cell: invoke spawn accepts the goal with the exact connector readiness budget a follower must outlive
